# Local changes to simplecss 0.2.2

This copy comes from the locked crates.io package (Apache-2.0 OR MIT).
LumaPaint adds `:root` selector recognition, custom-property identifiers starting
with `--`, and balanced nested functions/quoted strings with a depth limit of 64.
The SVG adapter implements static custom-property cascade/substitution and calc;
this library does not run scripts, animations, or interactive pseudo-classes.
